claims: Bounded UInt and ULong scalar literals, binary arithmetic, comparison, bitwise operators, integral conversions and nullable/generic boxing with real Kotlin value-class metadata and JVM mangling. Internal temporaries remain boxed; no optimization, Android runtime or full-app claim.
limitations: UByte/UShort have imported scalar ABI and conversion coverage; contextual literals remain an explicit boundary.
Unsigned const evaluation, unsigned arrays/ranges, generic value-class bounds, and previously bounded value-class source contexts remain unsupported.
Only scalar compiled static value members are expanded; function/reified parameters and inaccessible nested JVM references are rejected.
inline_reference_policy: Expand the pinned method Code attribute, checking every referenced class/member for JVM accessibility at the call site. No library operation body is substituted by name.

reference_discrepancy.observed: Pinned spec still lists unsigned integer types as a TODO. Kotlin 2.3.21 compiler/stdlib metadata and actual JVM bytecode define the tested version-specific ABI.

app_assessment.reason: Actual unsigned app usage requires UIntArray and sorted arrays in the JUnit test; those semantics are outside this scalar family. No unchanged AndroidBible file pass is claimed.
